findings.message: lessonRow() in middleBand.test.ts annotated its return type as `Lesson` without importing that type from ./symbols. It compiled and ran fine only because both tsconfig.json and tsconfig.domain-check.json exclude *.test.ts from type-checking, and vitest's esbuild transform strips types without checking them — so no gate this repo runs would ever have caught it. Fixed by adding `type Lesson` to the existing `./symbols` import.

lessons.lesson: Both tsconfig.json and tsconfig.domain-check.json exclude *.test.ts, and vitest's esbuild transform never type-checks — so a missing/wrong type import in any *.test.ts silently passes every gate this repo runs. Worth a real tsc pass over test files occasionally, since nothing else will catch it.
